lignes.pinyin: nǐ jiāng lái xiǎng zuò shén me
lignes.en: What do you want to do in the future?

lignes.zh: 我想当老师，教孩子们汉语。
lignes.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng dāng lǎo shī jiāo hái zi men hàn yǔ
lignes.fr: Je veux devenir professeur et enseigner le chinois aux enfants.
lignes.en: I want to be a teacher and teach children Chinese.

lignes.zh: 弟弟说他将来要当司机。
lignes.pinyin: dì di shuō tā jiāng lái yào dāng sī jī
lignes.fr: Mon petit frère dit que plus tard, il sera chauffeur.
lignes.en: My little brother says he'll be a driver when he grows up.
